prompts.B: Use case: style-transfer. Asset: a single three-tile horizontal material albedo atlas, exactly three equal square panels edge-to-edge, no margins, labels, separators or lighting. Left panel: repaint reference image 1's basalt UV atlas, preserving the EXACT silhouettes, locations and scale of all UV islands and black padding; no moving islands. Middle panel: repaint reference image 2's dry rust dirt texture, preserving large fissure placement and terra-cotta palette. Right panel: seamless muted blue-green ceramic enamel with modest worn areas and a few hairline abrasions; flat texture without any drawn object, hardware or frame. Flat diffuse albedo only, no directional shadows, no ambient occlusion, no beveled lighting. Preserve believable material identity. No plants, logos, text or objects. Treatment: subtle painterly stylized realism. Retain approximately 75 percent realistic material structure and restrained fine pores, with about 25 percent carefully placed hand-painted scumbling, broad color grouping and broken brush edges. Visual craft like Arcane and No Rest for the Wicked but quieter and grounded. Dark charcoal basalt remains dark, not white. Dirt remains naturally uneven. Brushwork is intentional, varied in scale and not repeated dabs or camouflage. This is the understated version.
prompts.C: Use case: style-transfer. Asset: a single three-tile horizontal material albedo atlas, exactly three equal square panels edge-to-edge, no margins, labels, separators or lighting. Left panel: repaint reference image 1's basalt UV atlas, preserving the EXACT silhouettes, locations and scale of all UV islands and black padding; no moving islands. Middle panel: repaint reference image 2's dry rust dirt texture, preserving large fissure placement and terra-cotta palette. Right panel: seamless muted blue-green ceramic enamel with modest worn areas and a few hairline abrasions; flat texture without any drawn object, hardware or frame. Flat diffuse albedo only, no directional shadows, no ambient occlusion, no beveled lighting. Preserve believable material identity. No plants, logos, text or objects. Treatment: confident painterly stylized realism. Clearly visible skilled oil-paint-like brushwork, broad grouped facets and broken scumbled edges that describe stone, earth and ceramic. Keep large structures and a believable tonal range, but simplify most fine photographic grain. Visual craft inspired by Arcane and No Rest for the Wicked, grounded and material-specific. Dark charcoal basalt remains dark, not white. Avoid cartoon outlines, cel bands, camouflage patches and repetitive procedural dabs. This version is visibly more painterly than a realistic material while retaining realistic material identity.
